title: Department of Computer Science and Engineering Organizes Python Programming Essentials Workshop for Second-Year Students - MGIT

## Department of Computer Science and Engineering Organizes Python Programming Essentials Workshop for Second-Year Students

News Date : 18 Jul 2023News ReportJuly 18, 2023The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at MGIT organized a three-day student workshop from July 13 to July 15, 2023, focusing on Programming Essentials in Python. The workshop was conducted in association with TASK and aimed to equip second-year students with the necessary skills to undertake mini projects or online internships in machine learning using Python.The workshop, attended by enthusiastic students, received an overwhelming response. The primary objective was to provide hands-on training in Python programming, enabling students to delve into the world of machine learning. Python, known for its simplicity and versatility, has become a popular language in the field of data science and artificial intelligence.Leading the workshop was Mr. K. Rakesh, an experienced trainer in Python and machine learning. With his in-depth knowledge and practical approach, Mr. Rakesh provided valuable insights and guidance to the participants. His engaging teaching style and interactive sessions made the learning experience enjoyable and productive for all.Upon completion of the workshop, students were given access to CISCO e-learning resources for further assessment and certification. This additional support from CISCO allows students to enhance their skills and obtain industry-recognized credentials in Python programming.The workshop not only provided a comprehensive understanding of Python programming but also fostered a sense of enthusiasm among the participants for exploring the vast possibilities of machine learning. By gaining practical knowledge and the ability to develop mini projects, students are now better prepared to excel in their future endeavors in the field of data science.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at MGIT remains committed to organizing such workshops and training programs, enabling students to stay at the forefront of technological advancements. With a strong emphasis on practical learning and industry collaboration, MGIT continues to empower its students to become competent professionals in the rapidly evolving world of technology.

July 18, 2023
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at MGIT organized a three-day student workshop from July 13 to July 15, 2023, focusing on Programming Essentials in Python. The workshop was conducted in association with TASK and aimed to equip second-year students with the necessary skills to undertake mini projects or online internships in machine learning using Python.
The workshop, attended by enthusiastic students, received an overwhelming response. The primary objective was to provide hands-on training in Python programming, enabling students to delve into the world of machine learning. Python, known for its simplicity and versatility, has become a popular language in the field of data science and artificial intelligence.
Leading the workshop was Mr. K. Rakesh, an experienced trainer in Python and machine learning. With his in-depth knowledge and practical approach, Mr. Rakesh provided valuable insights and guidance to the participants. His engaging teaching style and interactive sessions made the learning experience enjoyable and productive for all.
Upon completion of the workshop, students were given access to CISCO e-learning resources for further assessment and certification. This additional support from CISCO allows students to enhance their skills and obtain industry-recognized credentials in Python programming.
The workshop not only provided a comprehensive understanding of Python programming but also fostered a sense of enthusiasm among the participants for exploring the vast possibilities of machine learning. By gaining practical knowledge and the ability to develop mini projects, students are now better prepared to excel in their future endeavors in the field of data science.
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at MGIT remains committed to organizing such workshops and training programs, enabling students to stay at the forefront of technological advancements. With a strong emphasis on practical learning and industry collaboration, MGIT continues to empower its students to become competent professionals in the rapidly evolving world of technology.
